GERALD WRIGHT 


SIR GEORGE WILLIAMS 
UNIVERSITY AND SCHOOLS 


May 28th, 1963 


H. LESLIE SMITH, DIRECTOR, ANNOUNCED TODAY 
THE LIST OF AWARDS AND GRADUATING STUDENTS 
FROM THE SIR GEORGE WILLIAMS SCHOOL OF ART. 
THE AWARDS AND DIPLOMAS WILL BE PRESENTED 

BY DOUGLASS BURNS CLARKE, VICE-PRINCIPAL OF 
SIR GEORGE WILLIAMS UNIVERSITY, AT SPECIAL 
CEREMONIES TO BE HELD WEDNESDAY AT 8:00 P.M. 
IN BIRKS HALL, SIR GEORGE WILLIAMS UNIVERSITY, 
1435 DRUMMOND STREET. 


AWARDS 
THE BIRKS MEDAL-- 


To the graduating student with the 
highest academic and general pro- 
ficiency achievement, awarded to 
Betty Eisenwasser. 


THE ROBERT SIMPSON PRIZE-- 


To the graduating student with the 
highest academic and general pro- 
ficiency achievement, awarded 
Betty Eisenwasser. 


{ 


THE HUGHES OWENS PRIZE-- 


To a graduating student for general 
proficiency in all subjects, to 
Joan Howard. 


THE CLASSIC BOOKSHOP PRIZE-- 


To a second year sfudent for pro- 
ficiency in drawing, pecinting, and 
design, awarded to Chantal Dupont. 


THE HUGHES OWENS PRIZE-- 


To a second year student for general 
proficiency in drawing, painting, and 
fashion drawing, awarded to Francois 
Archambeault. 


THE CLASSIC BOOKSHOP PRI ZE-- 


To a first year student for achieve- 
ment in life drawing and design, 
awarded to Daph:e Tucker. 


THE ROBERT SIMPSON PRIZE-- 


To a first year student for general 
proficiency, awarded to Syd Menkes. 


THE GLADU AWARD-- 


To a student in first year for ex- 
cellence in Lettering and Typography, 
awarded to Peter Gyapay. 


SCHOLARSHIPS 

THE LATE CAPTAIN MELVILLE GREENSHIELDS SCHOLARSHIP-- 
To a second year student in the School 
of Art for general proficiency in all 


subjects and the highest total standing 
in second year, awarded to Joan Forbes. 


THE JAMES McKORKINDALE SCHOLARSHIP-- 
To a first year student in the School 
of Art for general proficiency in all 


subjects and the highest total standing 
in the first year, awarded to Pierre Dion.
